description: Weekly reconstruction from every official Bitmine release since Nov 30, 2025. Share counts are official at 10-Q checkpoints (checkpoints.json) and estimated between them by rolling the current model forward from the latest checkpoint. est_* / assumed_* fields are estimates; see README "Share-count reconstruction".

buyback_aggregate.note: 'In 2026, Bitmine has repurchased 22.9 million common shares, at an average price of $17.48 or an aggregate amount of $399.6 million' (Oct 26, 2026 release). Used to calibrate undisclosed weekly buyback prices.

method.weekly_cash_opex_source: Net operating cash outflow Dec 1, 2025 – May 31, 2026 = 9-month operating cash flow (−$287.592M, 10-Q May 31, 2026) − Sep–Nov (−$228.356M, 10-Q Nov 30, 2025) = −$59.236M over 26 weeks. Already net of interest income and cash service revenue. (v1 used $3,257,538 = Mar–May G&A − SBC + cost of sales ÷ 13.)
method.bmnp_weekly_dividend_source: 3,500,000 BMNP shares (June 10, 2026 offering) × $0.1847 regular weekly dividend (dividend schedule, 8-K Aug 14, 2026).
method.issue_price: average BMNR daily close over the week (range bounds use the week's highest / lowest close)
method.purchase_price: average daily ETH price over the week (CoinGecko) × eth_cost_factor
method.staking_rewards: ETH staked 4 reports earlier (min over the last 5 reports) × that week's stated 7-day BMNR yield (CESR when no Bitmine yield was stated) × days/365
method.investments_source: Disclosed cash spent on non-ETH investments in the weekly releases (Beast Industries $200M wk of Jan 25, Eightco/ORBS ~$80M wk of Mar 15, Pier Two ~$6M cash wk of Mar 29) — releases.json investments_usd.
method.staking_source: Rewards accrue only on ETH that was already staked 4 weekly reports earlier (validator entry-queue lag). Fitted to the 10-Q staking revenue: model $55.6M vs reported non-cash staking revenue $52.5M for Dec 2025–May 2026 (lag 0 gave $80.0M).
method.eth_cost_factor_source: Cash paid for ETH per the 10-Q cash-flow statements ÷ (ETH added − staking) × weekly average price: Dec–Feb 1.035, Mar–May 1.065, Dec–May 1.050. v1 used 1.0.
method.carry_forward_source: A week whose reported cash rose more than purchases explain is treated as a surplus that funds later weeks, instead of being discarded (v1 floored each week at zero).
